_comment: The curated half of the Vision tab. process-planned.cjs merges this with OpenStreetMap geometry and Metro İstanbul's published project facts.
WHAT LIVES HERE: the things no feed can supply and sources disagree on - which projects exist, their status, dated opening
targets, dated progress figures - each with a source id from `sources` below. Geometry is NEVER typed in: it comes from OSM
via `osm`, or the project has no line.
1. A target or progress figure needs `src` and `asOf`. If two sources disagree, record the most recent in `target` and the
other in `alt` - do not pick silently and do not average.
2. `status` is one of: Under construction | Planned | On hold | Long-term plan.
3. `target.date` (ISO) only when a source states a day. A quarter/half/year goes in `text` with `end` set to the LAST day of
that period, so a vague target is shown as 'by', never as 'on'.
4. Never set a line live by date here: a planned line becomes an active one by being moved into the live data, not by a
5. `verified` is the day a human last checked the claims against their sources. The report flags entries older than
clip points are a station name, [lat,lng], '@start' or '@end'. `parts` unions several matched sets (a project OSM maps in

projects.officialTr: M4 · Şehitler – Forum Raylı Sistem Uzatma Hattı
notes: Final designs approved 11 Dec 2024; left out of the 2026 Public Investment Programme, so no construction funding yet.

The mayor said in Jan 2026 the first phase would be in service 'within 2027'; a May 2026 press report says 2028 and links the delay to a halted EBRD loan instalment. The 47% is for the whole 765-million-euro project.
About 20 km of twin-tube tunnel had been dug by 30 Jan 2026; 108 vehicles in 18 driverless sets are planned and 400,000 passengers a day expected.

Three more stations take the line to 14 (İzmir BB) or 15 (a June 2026 press report) and a total of 17.8 km; the tunnels were expected to reach Fuar İzmir by the end of 2027 — a date for the tunnels, not for opening.

notes: Ceremonial groundbreaking in January 2023. As of 28 Jan 2026 the municipality said the final project was nearing completion, the tender was next, and it was seeking inclusion in the Presidential Investment Programme. OpenStreetMap tags it as under construction; the municipality's own statement is the one used here.
Three phases: Çalı–Üçevler, Üçevler–Terminal, Terminal–Demirtaş. As of 28 Jan 2026 drilling and corridor work were under way with the Ministry's infrastructure directorate (AYGM). No date announced.

Construction contract signed 21 Aug 2024 but the project missed the 2024, 2025 and (initially) 2026 investment programmes; it was added to the 2026 programme in mid-January 2026. In September 2026 the council approved external financing and was still negotiating with lenders, so ground has not been confirmed broken.
18 stations, 5 of them underground; cost about 23.4 billion TL.

The 2028 target is Wikipedia's; the 3 Sep 2026 progress report does not state an opening date. Six TBMs have dug 8.3 km of 52.3 km of tunnel (15.8%); work is under way at 17 of 19 stations. Kocaeli BB quotes 29.1 km where Wikipedia has 28.7 km.
